text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The end-of-year Grand Prix at Nakayama, 
the Arima Kinen. A battle royale where the 
mighty gathered, igniting fierce passion 
in spectators and runners alike.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone clashed head-on with the results 
of everything they had built up to this 
day. It seemed to be quite stimulating for 
Marvelous Sunday as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with meetings of new brilliances, 
the Classic year drew its curtains to a 
close—
